tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (497)༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi grub chen mi tra dzo ki la gsungs pa'i rang gi sems nyid ngal gso ba'i man ngag bzhugs so/ /
(497)༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi grub chen mi tra dzo ki la gsungs pa'i rang gi sems nyid ngal gso ba'i man ngag bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (497)༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi grub chen mi tra dzo ki la gsungs pa'i rang gi sems nyid ngal gso ba'i man ngag bzhugs so//

(498)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ rang gi sems ngal gso ba'i tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa 'di la gsum/ klad dang*/ gzhung dang*/ mjug go /dang po la gnyis/ mtshan bstan pa dang*/ 'gyur gyi phyag go /dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du/ swa tsit+ta bi shra mo ba de sha pañtsa biṃ shī gā thā/ bod skad du/ rang gi sems ngal gso ba'i man ngag tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ gnyis pa ni/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// gsum pa la dbu las/ ༈ dang po sor bzhag gsum gyi ngo sprad pa ni/ e ma ho/ rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// 'khor dang 'das pa'i byed rgyu can// gzhan min rang gi snying dbus nas// bla ma'i zhal nas shes par 'gyur// gang skyes gnyug ma nyid yin phyir// gang shar dran pas ma brjod nas// de shar stong pa nyid dag tu// rnal 'byor rgyal po gdon mi za// gang shar thams cad de yin te// de ni gang du'ang ma shar ba'o// de phyir gang skyes de ma skyes// ma skyes pa nyid skyes pa'i tshul// ༈ gnyis pa la gsum gyi dpe'i ngo sprod/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum sdig mdzub mdzad// (499)rdo rje'i lta bas bltas nas ni// rta mchog dal bus 'gro 'ong la// gnas nas du ma gcig tu bya// rkang pa rgya mtsho che la bzhag /lag pa sa steng kun tu nyul// mig gnyis nam mkhar blta bya ste// yid ni gang du'ang mi g.yo ba'o// sgeg mo'i le long stobs kyi byad// khri btsun brgyal po'i btsun mo dang*// phyag dar pa dang smad 'tshong bzhin// gcig pu grogs dang 'grogs par byos// ༈ gsum pa phyi nang bar gsum gyi dpe'i ngo sprod/ stag dang seng ge glang chen dang*// rnga mo khri snyan spre'u dang*// tsan dan sdong po mi ro ltar// mkhas pa stong nyid rnal 'byor bya// ri gzar chu dang rgya mtsho che// bu gcig ma dang glang po skyong*// gangs ri dang ni shel dag bzhin// dmigs khral gyur na gzhi tshug pa'o// thog ma bar dang mthar rim bzhin// rtsa ba ngo bo byed bral ba// rmi lam gyi ni mar me bzhin// snying brtse mi g.yo goms pa 'grub//

༈ bzhi pa thog pa gsum gyi ngo sprod/ 'gro 'ong gnas ni skye gnas 'gags// rnam dag stong pa nyid rnam gsum// bde chen 'od gsal (500)rnam mi rtog /blo bzang rnams kyis mnyam par bzhag /snying rje chen po mdun bzhag ste// de nyid ma yengs rtag blta zhing*// lha dang bla ma'i sbyor ba yis// sgrub pa po ni ngal gso bya// bu nyon khyod gang rnam par rtog /'dir bdag ma bcings ma grol phyir// ma yengs ma bcos rang dgar ni// kye ho dub pa ngal gso shig / ༈ lnga pa sbyor ba gsum gyi ngo sprod/ gzugs brnyan gzugs dang brag cha sgra// dngos dang rmi lam dran pa'i yin// ting nge 'dzin dang 'brel ba dang*// zad pa bsgom pa'i sbyor ba'o// so sor rtog dang rten 'brel dang*// rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad bsgom pa// gser bzhin me bzhin nam mkha' bzhin// shes byed zhi byed dag par byed// snang med de snang rkyen gyis snang*// nam mkha' me long shel dag bzhin// ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes te// gzungs kyi sgo yis de rtogs byed// ༈ drug pa sgo mo gsum gyi ngo sprod/ ༈ mthong ba mnyam bzhag 'od gsal te// de tshe de mthong de ma skyes// shin tu mi rtog rtse gcig gnas// g.yengs pa'i rdul dang bral ba nyid// rlung gi gar 'gro der sems 'gro// de lus khyim nang btson bzung ste// yid kyi skyes bu bsad byas na// de med sems ni gang du 'gro// thams cad rang bzhin ma bcos pa// kun rtog thams cad rkyen kyi dbang*// rang bzhin gsum gyi de shes na// kun rtog kun rtog med par byed// ༈ bdun pa dgag sgrub gsum gyi ngo sprod/ mthong bas grub dang gzhig pa na// med ces rnam par rtog pa zad// 'di la gdod nas ci yang med// bu kye nam mkha' sgom par byos// ga bur dang ni de yi dri// phan tshun de med de yang med// de bzhin rkyen dang rkyen bral ba// so sor ma yin rang dgar bsgom// mnyam pa'i sems kyis g.yo ba 'gog

/mi mnyam dran pas 'ching bar byed// de tshe dag dang bral mnyam bzhag /rnam par rtog pa gsod par byed// ༈ brgyad pa dbang bzhi'i ngo phrod/ khrus (501)byas nam mkha' gos gyon la// rnam par rtog pa sbyin sreg bya// dran pa'i thal ba 'jug ngogs su// chu klung lhan cig sbyong bar byos// snod bcud rlung rgyun brtan g.yo mkha'// nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan 'dzin// me khyer char dang bung ba'i dpes// dam tshig phyag rgya dbang du 'gyur// sna tshogs yid ni me tog la// dga' ba bzhi yi bcud blangs te// lhan cig skyes pa'i ro myong na// yid kyi skyes bu tshim par byed// lus rlung rtsa chen phyag rgya yis// lus ngag yid ni bcing bar bya// drod thogs pa la thog pa med// kun spyod nges par mi bya'o// gsum pa mjug gi don la gnyis/ gzhung gi rdzogs byang dang*/ 'gyur byang ngo*// dang po ni/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi sems ngal gso bar byed pa'i man ngag tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu lnga pa zhes bya ba de kho na nyid rnal du mtshon par byed pa'i do ha rdzogs so// gnyis pa ni/ jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyid dngos su gnang ba'i grub pa mnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ka ṭa mi tra ā nan+da dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis dpal gu lang gser khang gi nang khrod aṃ pa ri'i bsil khang du bsgyur ba'o// ༈ rje btsun sku drin can rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rang sems snying po don gyi ngo sprod pa la don gsum ste/ gsol 'debs kyis byin rlabs dbab pa man ngag gi gnad kyis rang ngo rang la sprod pa dang*/ rgyas 'debs dang bsngo bas snang ba lam du khyer ba'o// dang po ni/ gnas dben par rten dang*/ dam rdzas ci rigs par bshams la/ skyabs 'gro dang*/ sems bskyed bya/ rang lus skyil krung mnyam bzhag la sogs pa bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya bca'// spyi bor seng khri pad+ma zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa la rtsa ba'i bla ma ting nge 'dzin mchog gi phyag rgya can/

byin gyis rlob rlob ltar bzhugs par bsam/ rang gi snying pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa kha phyed bye phyed ma bye ba'i nang (502)nang du/ rtsa ba'i yi dam gyi lha gang yin de gsal bar bsgom/ de nas bdag nyid kyis khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad khrid la thun mong gi mchod pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod pa dang*/ khyad par gyi mchod pa dang*/ gsum dbul ba las/ dang po ni/ me tog dang*/ spos dang*/ mar me dang*/ dri chab dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ rol mo dang*/ bstod pa dpag tu med pa 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal snod bcud rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba dang*/ khyad par du yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba dang*/ gter gyi bum pa dang*/ khrus kyi rdzing bu la sogs pa blos lcogs tshad dbul/ gnyis pa ni/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil gyi bar zhe thag pa nas g.yog dang bran du dbul// gsum pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis byas pa'i dge ba thams cad kyang*/ thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i rgyur dbul lo// de nas thal mo sbyar la/ dam pa gsum ldan gyis gsol ba gdab ste/ nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ma rnams phyir// bla ma thugs rje chen po yis// bdag la rtogs pa'i mchog bskyed gsol// mkhyen pas gzigs shing thugs rjes zung*// zhes yang yang brjod cing*/ gdung ba drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma dang lha gnyis ka las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung ste/ nyes sgrib thams cad lhag ma ma lus par sbyangs par bsam mo// de'i tshe/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ zhes pa'am/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla'o// sngon 'gro rdzogs so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i man ngag ni/ gnad kyi rang ngo rang la sprad pa gsum ste/ dang po ma yengs bar bzhag pa ral bskor mkhan g.yul du zhugs pa lta bu dang*/ bar du ma bcos par btsal ba mkhas par glang po che skyong ba lta bu dang*/ tha ma ci dgar btang bas gzings thog nas bya 'phur ba lta bu'o// dang po lus sems kyi stsal (503)ba thams cad bor la/

lhod de shig ge sal le/ hur re/ yer re/ rjen ne/ phya le bzhag go /rnam rtog gang byung yang skyon du mi blta/ rjes su mi 'brang*/ sngar gyi ma bcos pa glod bde som shor bar gnyug bsrings la bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ de'i ngang las phyi nang gi snang ba mtho dman gang byung*/ byung chos de ye mi dgag par gang byung bar lhod kyis glod/ gang byung ba'i tshe/ byung mkhan rang ngo rang gis shes par bya ste/ rab kyis sor bzhag 'bring gis ngos bzung*/ tha mas 'gyu ba'i rtsad bcad do// brtsad bcad pas/ ma rnyed pa'i ngang la 'bad rtsol thams cad bral bas/ chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bya'o// gsum pa ni/ mnyam bzhag rjes thob kyi rim pa med par/ sngar gyi nyams myong de dang ma bral bar dran pa'i rtsis bzung la/ yul sna tshogs la 'phro ba'i shes pa ci bder gtong*/ chags sdang dang bde sdug gang byung tshad ma bcos pa de kho rang gi rtsal yin pas/ rang ngo rang gis shes pa tsam gyis chog /de ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje ngang gis skyes te/ des kun nas bslangs nas rig pa 'od gsal ma 'gags pa'i rtsal gzhan don rgya chen pos sbyang ste/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i do ha las/ snang ba'i dug ni stong par dbyung*// stong pa'i rtsal ni snang bas sbyang*// gnyis ka'i bogs ni gnyis kas 'don// gnyis med bsgoms pas gnyis 'dzin 'dzad// ces gsungs so// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ rgyas 'debs pa dang bsngo ba ni/ stong pa rkyang pa'i nyams len la mi bzhag par/ thabs mkhas pa lha'i rnal 'byor dang zung du 'brel bas/ phyi'i snod gzhal yas khang*/ bcud lha dang lha mo/ rang gi lus lha sku/ ngag sngags/ yid ting nge 'dzin 'gro ba bskor/ smra ba bzlas brjod/ za (504)ba tshogs 'khor/ gon pa chos gos/ byas tshad chos spyod du rgyas gdab/ de ltar gzhi snang stong zung 'jug la lam thabs dang shes rab kyis nyams su len/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs zung 'jug tu bsags pas/

'bras bus chos sku dang gzugs sku zung 'jug rdzogs pa yin no// de bas na ji ltar sgrub pa/ de ltar bsngo ba gal che bas/ dge ba rgya chen dri med 'dis// 'gro kun sgrib gnyis gtan bsal te// tshogs gnyis bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'brel bas// sku gnyis 'bras bu myur thob shog /ces bsngo ba bya'o// gnad kyi ngo sprod gsum pa bdud rtsi'i nying khu lta bu'i man ngag rdzogs so/// / ༈ rje btsun sku drin can la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa gsum ldan byin rlabs kyis// rang sems sku gsum ngo sprod cing*/ thabs chen dran pa gsum ldan gyis// 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpal la 'dud// man ngag 'di la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dam pa gsum ldan gyi gsol 'debs/ dngos gzhi sku gsum ngo sprod gnad/ rjes dran pa gsum ldan gyi thabs so// dang po ni/ nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ma rnams phyir// bla ma thugs rje chen po yis// bdag la rtogs pa'i mchog bskyed gsol// mkhyen pas gzigs shig thugs rjes zung*// zhes bya'o// 'di'i don ni/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ snying gi dkyil du jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bsgoms la/ zab cing rgya che ba'i mchod pas mchod/ skyabs 'gro dang*/ sdig bshags dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*/ de ma thag tu nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bla ma dang*/ ngo bo thugs rje chen pos/ bdag gi rgyud la rtogs pa khyad par du 'phags par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab/ de thams cad la rten dam (505)bca' bar 'dzin pa/ rang rgyud la gdung ba drag po/ rtog pa la 'dun pa'i shugs can de gal che'o// de nas bla ma rang la thim pas bla ma'i rtogs pa rang la 'phros par bsam/ jo bo rang la thim pas jo bo'i sku gsung thugs su bsgom mo// de ltar gsol ba gdab pa la rgyas par bsgom na/ gsol ba gdab dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/

'debs pa'i gnad/ ji ltar gdab pa'i tshul gsum las// dang po la gsum las/ gsol ba gdab pa'i phan yon gsum/ ma btab pa'i nyes pa gsum/ btab na thebs pa'i gsum las/ dang po ni/ don myur du thob pa tshong pas lam du zong rnyed pa lta bu/ tshogs chud pa 'jim pa la brkos phor gyi rgyas btab pa lta bu/ phun sum tshogs pa pad+ma 'dam nas skyed pa lta bu'o// ma btab pa'i nyes pa gsum ni/ 'dod kyang ma rnyed pa phongs pas nor tshol ba lta bu/ tshogs che ba snyim pas chu len pa lta bu/ phun sum tshogs pa 'khos chung gi lag byad lta bu'o// gsol ba btab pas thebs pa'i dpe gsum ni/ rten gyi sgo nas rtog pa med kyang dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu/ rang gi sgo nas nus pas 'dun pa 'dren pa gdung bas mchi ma 'byung ba lta bu/ gnyis ka'i rten 'brel zab pa spra ba la me 'bar ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa gsol ba 'debs pa'i gdan la gsum ste/ rten lus la dgong*// cho ga ngag tu bzla/ gdung ba sems la bskyed pa'o// ji ltar gdab pa'i tshul gsum ste/ dong ba yun ring ma 'phrad pa'i ma lta ba// gdung ba rnga mo rje'u stor ba lta bu// 'dod pa 'jigs par skyel ma tshol ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi sku gsum ngo sprad pa la/ snang mkhan rang la rang so tshugs// snang med snying rje chen por bsgyur// gnyis med thug phrad lam du bsgyur// ma yengs ma bcos ci dkar zhog /ces bya'o// (506)'di'i don ni/ gsol ba thebs pa'i rjes la/ rig pa gang ltar snang yang*/ snang mkhan rang nyid rang stong yin pas/ rang ngo rang gis shes par byas la/ de nyid so tshugs par bzhag go /des snang mkhan rang sar grol bas/ chos sku dri med mngon du 'gyur ba'i gdams ngag yin no// snang med rkyang pa las 'gro don mi 'gyur bas// shes rab dri ma med pa de nyid ma rtogs pa la snying rje chen por bsgyur la byang chub kyi sems sbyang ngo*// des snying rje chen po yongs su dag pas rang gzhan gyi chos kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'char ba'i gnad yin no// de'i ngang las bzang ngan gyi 'du byed ci byung yang*// rang ngo shes pas rang grol du 'gyur te// de nyid rang don phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu tshang la ma nor zhing bde la myur ba yin no de kho na ltar sems can thams cad kyang rang grol du gyur cig

/ces gzhan don du bsngos pas/ de nyid gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu tshang la ma nor zhing bde la myur ba yin no// des 'phral du ci byung byung thug phrad lam du bslangs pas/ gang la gang gis ji ltar 'dul 'dul gyi don byed pa'i sprul sku thogs med du 'byung ba'i gnad yin no// de dag thams cad du yang*/ dang po ma yengs par bzhag /bar du ma bcos par btsa'/ mthar ci dgar bskyang ba gal che'o// de ltar ngo sprad pa la yang*/ rgyas par bsgom na don gsum ste/ ngo sprad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ sprod par byed pa'i gnad/ ji ltar sprod pa'i tshul lo// dang po gsum ste/ ngo sprod pa'i yon tan dang*/ ma 'phrod pa'i nyes pa dang*/ sprad na 'phrod pa'i dpe'o// dang po la gsum ste/ sangs rgyas rang la rnyed pa dbul pos khyim du gter rnyed pa lta bu/ sdug bsngal bde bar 'gyur ba gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags gser du bsgyur ba lta bu/ nyon mongs pa grogs su 'char ba dug la sngags btab pa lta bu/ (507)ma 'phrod pa'i nyes pa gsum ni/ rang ngo rang gi ma shes pa gdon gyis brlab pa'i smyon pa lta bu/ ci byed sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba dug can gyi zas zos pa lta bu/ nyon mongs pa spang gis mi spangs pa nags la me mched pa lta bu'o// sprad na phrod pa'i dpe ni/ snang ba'i sgo nas rang snang stong par thim pa chab rom chur shes pa lta bu/ stong pa'i sgo nas stong nyid snang bar shar ba chu nang gi zla ba lta bu/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas snang stong dbyer med du rtogs pa nam mkha' 'ja' tshon lta bu'o// ngo sprod pa'i gnad la gsum ste/ sor bzhag gnyug ma la ngo sprad/ rang grol 'gyur ba la ngo sprod/ thug 'phrad rgyun chags su ngo sprad pa'o// ngo 'phrod pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ dang po ma yengs par bzhag pas ral bskor mkhan g.yul du zhugs pa lta bu/ bar du ma ma bcos par btsa' ba la mkhas pas glang po che bskyang ba lta bu/

tha mar ci dgar btang ba gzings thog nas bya 'phur ba lta bu'o// gsum pa rjes su dran pa gsum ldan gyi thabs ni/ mnyam rjes snga phyi dran pas 'brel// rgyun chags rgyas 'debs dran rgyas gdab// snying phugs gzhan don dran pas bzung*// kun la gsal rig chags med ces// zhes bya ba'o// 'di'i don ni/ ting nge 'dzin de las longs la mnyam rjes 'brel pa'i dran pas sgyu ma lta bu'i blos sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa'i don du/ deng phyin chad bsam pa gang dang gang la yengs kyang*/ mnyam par bzhag ma bzhag rang bzhin gyis mtshungs par mtshams sbyar/ rgyun chags 'brel ba'i dran pas sangs rgyas thob thob kyi bar du rgyun chags med par rgyas gdab/ gzhan don 'phen pa'i dran pas dge ba'i rtsa thams cad snying thag pa nas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la ltos pa med par btang ngo*// de thams cad (508)du yang mtshams sbyar la sngar 'dren dang phyis snyigs dang rgyas 'debs la skabs kyi gsal 'debs dang*/ mthar thug la gzhan don snying phugs su gzhugs pa do gal che'o// de ltar dran pa gsum gyi thabs la yang*/ rgyas par bye na/ nyams su blang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ nyams su blangs pa'i gnad/ ji ltar len pa'i tshul gsum las/ dang po la yang gsum ste/ nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon/ ma blangs pa'i nyes pa/ blang na longs pa'i dpe bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ ma bsgoms kyang sgom pa'i go chod pa gzer dang ma bral ba'i 'khrul 'khor lta bu/ bsod nams bar ma chad du 'brel ba gangs chu dang rgya mtsho lta bu/ ci byas gnad du 'phog pa dpag chen gyi mda' lta bu'o// ma blangs pa'i nyes pa la'ang gsum ste/ mnyam rjes ya bral du zhig pa shing rta'i gzer chag pa lta bu/ 'bad 'bras grub khar nyams pa lcags tshos khar med bsad pa lta bu/ dka' spyad snying po med pa'i chu dang shing gi sdong po bskyed pa lta bu'o// nyams su blangs pas longs pa'i dpe gsum ste/

snga phyi 'brel ba'i sgo nas nus mthu gcig tu 'grub pa zho'i ru ma lta bu/ rgyun chags 'brel ba'i sgo nas tha mal gyis bar mi chad pa rnal 'byor pa'i srung 'khor lta bu/ gnyis kas gzhan don sgrub pa'i sgo nas sman shing gi sa bon las sdong po skye ba lta bu'o// nyams su blang ba'i gnad la gsum ste/ ma brjed pa zungs su bzung*/ gsal 'debs gzer du gdab/ zhen 'khris khong nas bcad pa'o// ji ltar blangs pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ sngar 'dren dang phyis snyegs la mkhas pa skyes bu goms pa'i 'phangs stsal lta bu/ zhar nas zhar du gso ba me la shing bsnon pa lta bu/ phugs gtad gzhan la lta ba bu gcig pa'i ma lta bu'o// sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi (509)thabs dang gsum mo// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i bla ma las// bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dra'i man ngag thob// dpag bsam shing 'dra'i 'bras bu smin// dmigs med mkha' 'dra'i tshogs rdzogs shog /gsum tshan gsum gyi man ngag ces kyang bya gces pa'i snying po zhes bya ba snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ triṃ sha hi a ba bo dha/ bod skad du/ rtog pa brjod pa sum bcu pa/ jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// ༈ rdo rje 'dzin pa tshangs dbang gtsug /chu skyes ched bus 'jig rten mgon// 'od zer rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas// e ma dri gsum dag mdzad rmad// ༈ brten pa'i lus ni ri mo 'dra// spros bral sems ni nam mkha' ste// g.yo ba'i sems ni rlung rgyan bcings// tshul 'dis rnal 'byor bdag legs grol// ༈ yid ni khyab 'jug nam mkha' ste// 'khor lo lnga'i rang bzhin lus// srog rtsol nyi ma zla ba gnyis// bde chen rdo rje'i zhags pas bcings// ༈ dri ma lnga ni lnga yis sbyangs// lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs// de dag ma bcos skye ba med// e ma 'di na bsgom bya gang*// rgya mtsho'i snying po me 'bar bas// ri rab srog shing shi rta brgyud// tshangs dbang rtse nas char rgyun 'bebs// thabs kyis thabs bral de la ltos// gang ma rig pa de stong nyid// kun nas dkris pa bde ba'i tshal// zhe sdang 'bar ba 'od gsal che// lha mchog gi de gang gis bcings// lte ba'i mar mes mun pa bsal// snying gar shes rab pad+ma rgyas// spyi gtsug bde chen ye shes 'dzag

/de ni rang lus dngos grub 'gyur// rtsa gsum 'khor lo 'dus pa'i dbus// bde chen dwangs ma'i thig le gnas// (510)de dbus rnam par mi rtog pa// ye shes mig gcig dri med nyid// gzung 'dzin mun par rtogs pa'i 'dod// nam mkha' la ni nyi shar bzhin// der yang mi gnas gzhan du min// kye ho shin tu zab pa'i gnas// 'jig rten thams cad nam mkhas bcings// nam mkha' de yi sprin gyis bsgribs// gang tshe rtog pa'i sprin nag pa// de tshe 'di la ci zhig snang*// sgyu mas sgyu ma'i grong khyer btsam// sems kyis sems ni bslu ba ste// 'di la bdag 'dras bslu med rigs// e ma 'o e ma bla ma'i drin// 'og ni las kyi 'khor los bsdams// bar ni rdo rje'i mdud pas bcings// steng du yi ge gyon du bsgyur// thabs 'di bdag gir rang la rnyed// ༈ lus ni ri bo 'dra byas la// ngag ni rlung rgyun lta bur bsdams// sems ni nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// dbyer med chos nyid kun gyi dngos// brtan lus shing rta rab bcas pa// g.yo ba srog shing lam du gzhugs// de ltar bcings pa'i ting nge 'dzin// 'chi med nam mkha'i dngos grub 'thob// nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rnam mi rtog /yang dag lha ni bde ba che// de yi zung 'jug 'od gsal nyid// gnas 'dir ngal gso mkhas pa dag /rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje rgyal po rdo rje bde// rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' stong*// e ma rdo rje kun rig pa'o// me tog mthong bas rtsi mi mthong*// chab rom mthong bas chu ma yin// lus mthong bde ba blang bar gyis// sems mthong mthong ba ma mchis so// chu nang skyes bu su yi bu// rmi lam grong khyer bdag po med// me long gzugs ni gang las 'ongs// 'gro ba 'di kun de dang 'dra// gang na gnas dang skye ba dang*// 'gag 'gyur yul rgyu dus med pa// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid chos 'di la// kye ho (511)'jigs pa gang zhig yod// 'di dag snang ba snang brnyan tsam// rig pa de yang rig pas dben// thams cad rig snyam shes snyam ste// snyam tsam de yang snyam nyid med// skyes bu don kun grub pa 'di// zhe sdang nyi ma 'od gsal lta// 'dod chags zla ba de bas spyod// gti mug sgra gcan mi rtog 'dzoms//

༈ nam mkha'i sprin dang rgya mtsho'i rlabs// me tog rtsi dang ga bur dri// me long gzugs dang shel dkar bzhin// rnam rtog mi rtog dngos dbyer med// 'gro ba 'di dag las las skyes// las ni nyon mongs de yi rgyu// mtshan ma yin te de shes nas// skyes bu mtshan med rnam par grol// rtog pa'i glang chen lcags kyus dgug /sems kyi bung ba rtsi yis bsdu// ting 'dzin ngang pa mtsho nang rtse// shes rab pad+mo nyi zer 'byed// yid kyi mar me mun pa sel// bde ba'i me tog bung bas 'jib// 'dzin pa'i rba rlabs rgya mtshor thim// bde sdug sprin de nam mkhar dengs// yi ge gsum gyi brdas mtshon pas// yi ge med pa bdag gis rtogs// rnal 'byor rgyal po yi ge mchog /sems las gzhan ni ma mchis so// gang du 'gro med 'gro ba 'di// gnas shes bya bar ga la 'gyur// gang mi gnas pa chos kyi dbyings// de la ji ltar 'gag 'gyur sems// rtag tu byed bral gti mug med// khong khro bag chags gtan bcom pa// zhi ba dam pa'i mya ngan 'das// gter chen rang la yod shes gyis// 'jig rten sgyu ma'i las kyis bsgrubs// sgyu ma sgyu ma yid kyis te// 'di kun sgyu ma nyid shes na// sgyu ma lta bur rnam par grol// sgyu mar rtogs pas bden rtog 'joms// rtog med sgyu ma la mi gnas// ༈ mi gnas 'gro la phan brtson pas// e ma nor bu rin chen rnyed// (512)rtogs pa brjod pa sum cu pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje grub thob chen po mi tra dzo ki de nyid kyi spyan sngar gnub lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o/// / ༈ rje btsun sku drin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs dpal dang*// shes rab mthar thug ro gcig ral gcig mas// byin rlabs grub chen rgyal po mi tra shrī'i// zhabs pad rdul la rab gus spyi bos 'dud// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brgyad cu rtsa lnga pa de'i rtogs pa brjod pa 'di ni re zhig thog ma kho nar// gtsug lag chen po dpal kha sar pa ṇir spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lo bcu gnyis su sgrubs pa'i tshe/

mthar rdo rje'i shing gtan sku khrus kyi me long dang bcas pa'i steng du 'jig rten mgon po rdo rje'i sku byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzi brjid 'bar ba/ khru do mdzub gang tsam gyi tshad dngos su gzigs nas/ des sems ngal sos par byed pa'i do ha tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa gsungs so// de'i tshe de ma thag stong pa dang*/ snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i rtogs pa bla na med pa 'khrungs te/ 'on kyang spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gzugs mi snang bar gyur ba la yid la gdung ba skyes pa las/ lhar nang du rang la rang gis bltas te/ mnyam par bzhag pas/ sngar thob pa'i gsung dbyangs/ do ha rdo rje'i mgur gyis nyams myong skyed pa'i mngon rtogs pa ni dper na chu mtsho dwangs pa las zla ba'i gzugs sam/ rgyas btab pa las 'bur bzhin du gsal zhing sgrib pa med par snang ba dang*/ zag pa med pa'i dga' ba des thugs tshim zhing rangs te/ spang la sha mo rdol ba bzhin/ rtogs pa brjod pa'i tshig sha lo ka sum cu po 'di dag thugs la shar nas zhal du phyung ba yin no// de'ang don gsum gyi nges par bya ste/ dang po bka' drin dran pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa (513)pa dang*/ bar do ngo 'phrod pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ tha ma sgrub pa mthar phyin pas don chen sgrub pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes pa la sogs pas bstan te/ spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar/ dam pa gsum ldan gyis gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs shing*/ chu skyes zhes pas snying gar yi dam lha'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral ba bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel gyi bzlas sgom bar ma chad kyi mthus/ thugs rje chen po'i dngos grub thob pa dang*/ 'od zer rgyun gyis zhes pas/ bla ma dang lha gnyis ka las gsal zhing dwangs pa'i 'od zer byung nas/ bdag la sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur bas zhes pa dang*/

mtshan ma dang snang ba'i dri ma gsum dag par mdzad pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ste thugs la btags so// zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa ba ngo 'phrad pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ yan lag ngo 'phrad pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ brtan pa'i lus zhes pa la sogs pas bstan te/ bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya bdun ldan gyis/ lus ri ltar brtan par byas nas sems ma yengs ma bcos pa nam mkha' ltar spros bral du mnyam par bzhag cing*/ g.yo ba'i dbugs rngub pa dang*/ dgang ba dang*/ gzhil ba dang mda' ltar gyen du 'phang ba'i tshul sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyis lte bar bcings te/ de ltar rgyun chags su bsgom pas/ rang sems ma bcos pa'i don ji ltar gnas pa ngo 'phrad do zhes bya ba'i don to// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lam gcig char pa'i sgo nas rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ lam rim gyis sgo nas rtogs pa brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ yid ni khyab 'jug ces pa la sogs pa ste/ lam gcig car pas 'khrul 'khor nyams su len pa las/ re zhig yid kyi 'khrul (514)'khor rgya che bas thams cad spro ba khyab 'jug lta bu dang zab pa rang bzhin stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bur bsgom pa'o// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor la 'khor lo lnga ste/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo dang*/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dang*/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ gsang ba las kyi 'khor lo dang lnga'o// rnam shes sgo lnga'i rten dbang po lnga nang du bcings pas/ rnam shes lnga shugs las 'ching ba'i thabs so// ngag gi 'khrul 'khor srog sems dang rtsol ba rlung gnyis/ byang sems dkar dmar nyi zla gnyis dbang du byed pa la mkhas pa'o// de ltar 'khrul 'khor gsum dbang du byas pas/ bde stong dbyer med kyi nyams myong gis lam gcig car du rtogs pa skyes te/ bde chen rdo rje zhes smos so// gnyis pa lam rim gyis pa la gsum ste/

dbang po tha ma'i dbang du byas te thun mong gi rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ 'bring gi dbang du byas te thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ rab kyi dbang du byas te khyad par rtogs pa brjod pa'o// dang po la dgu ste/ snang ba rang grol gyi rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ thabs 'bar 'dzag gi dang*/ dug gsum rtsa bral gyi dang*/ gtum mo ye shes kyi dang*/ 'khor lo gsum 'dus kyi dang*/ gnyis 'dzin sor bzhag gi dang*/ rang sems mkha' mnyam gyi dang*/ bslu brid ngos bzung gi dang*/ bde chen lam khyer gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ dri ma ldan ni zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ phyi ltar na phung po lnga'i nyes pa rgyal ba rigs lngas sbyang ba dang*/ nang ltar na sgo lnga'i rnam shes lnga'i rang ngo shes pas sbyang ba dang*/ gsang ba ltar na nyon mongs pa dug lnga ye shes su rang dag par shes pas sbyangs te/ de'i dri ma'i snang ba rang sar grol ba'o// lus lha skur grol/ ngag sngags su grol/ yid thugs su grol te/ (515)de ni sgo gsum rang sar grol ba'o// grol lugs ni de dag ma bcos// zhes gsungs pas/ gdod ma nas rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su dag pas bsgom bya bsgom byed ye stong ye bral lo// gnyis pa ni/ rgya mtsho'i snying po zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ rang grol rtogs pa'i thabs su/ lus rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i yi ge gnyis las 'bar 'dzag bsgom pa ste/ rlung lte bar bzung bas de 'og rgya mtsho'i snying po baṃ yig las gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar nas ri rab kyi srog shing a wa dhū ti'i sbugs nas brgyud de/ tshangs dbang gi gtsug gi haṃ zhu nas 'khor lo lnga'i rtsa sbugs thams cad gang zhing zim par byas pas/ bde gsal stong pa'i nyams myong ngang gis skye'o// de la thabs las byung ba'i thabs bral rtogs pa 'byung ste/ de la bltas na ya mtshan che'o// zhes bya'o// gsum pa ni/

gang ma rig pa zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ sems can thams cad gang gis 'ching ba'i rgyu nyon mongs pa dug gsum yin pa las/ ma rig pa rang ngo shes pas ngo bos stong nyid du rtogs pa 'char la/ 'dod chags rang ngo shes pas kun nas dkris pa rang sar dag ste/ bde chen du 'bar zhing*/ zhe sdang rang ngo shes pas/ kun tu 'khrug pas rang sar dag nas 'od gsal du 'gyur bas bcings pa thams cad rang grol du rtogs so// zhes bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ lte ba'i mar mes zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ lus thabs mgal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ rlung bum pa can bzung ste/ yid rdo rje 'bru gsum la blo khrid nas/ lte ba'i a las gtum mo'i mes ro smad gang bar 'bar bas 'od gsal gyi nyi ma 'char/ spyi gtsug gi haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bde chen 'bab/ snying ga'i hrīḥ'am hūm̐ la rtse gcig tu yid gtad pas/ mi rtog pa shes rab kyi pad+ma kha phye bar 'gyur bas rang (516)lus rang gi dngos grub thob bo zhes bya'o// lnga pa ni/ rtsa gsum zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ lus la rtsa dbu ma'i mgo bor/ ro rkyang gnyis kyis spyi bor 'khyud pa bde chen gyi 'khor lo dang*/ snying gar 'khyud pas chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ lte bar 'khyud pa sprul pa'i 'khor lo dang gsum dbang du bsdus pas/ zho dkrogs pa las mar gyi snying po bzhin du/ byang sems kyi rtsa ba dwangs ma'i thig le 'dus nas dhū tir me long dwangs pa la gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rang 'khrungs su skye bas/ ye shes mig gcig dri med du 'char ro// zhes bya'o// drug pa ni/ gzung 'dzin zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ yul gzung ba la blo 'gyus pa dang*/ blo 'dzin pa mtshan mar zhen pa gnyis ka rang ngo rang gis shes pas gnyid sad pa'i rmi lam dang rmi lam gyi yul gnyis ka ma grub par thag thod par ltar/ gzung 'dzin gnyis spang ma dgos par rang sar dag ste/

sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar/ rtogs pa'i 'od kyis ma rig pa dang*/ ye shes gnas der yang mi gnas shing*/ gzhan du'ang song bas shin tu zab pa yin no// zhes bya ba'o// bdun pa ni/ 'jig rten thams cad zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ 'di ltar snang ba'i sems can rnams ni/ rang sems nam mkha' dang 'dra bas bcings la/ nam mkha' de'ang sprin dang 'dra ba'i 'khrul pas bsgribs pa las/ sgrib byed rtog pa'i sprin rang sangs su gyur pas/ ma bcos pa nam mkha' lta bu la bzang ngan gyi snang ba ci yang mi 'byung ngo zhes bya'o// brgyad pa ni/ sgyu mas zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ gnyen pos spang bya bcom pa ni/ sgyu ma'i dmag gis sgyu ma'i grong bcom pa dang 'dra/ nyon mongs pa stong pa'i sems kyis nyon mongs can gyi sems bslu ba ste/ 'dir bla ma'i sku drin gyis bslus pa'i dus su bslu ba med par rtogs pas/ bslu brid ye shes su (517)ngos zin no// zhes bya'o// dgu pa ni/ 'og ni zhes pa la sogs pa ste gsang sgo las kyi 'khor lo 'og tu bsdam zhing*/ bar du rdo rje'i rgya mdud lte bar bcings la/ steng tshangs pa'i yi ge gyen du bsgyur bas gzhan lus la ma ltos par rang lus la bde stong dbyer med rnyed do zhes bya'o// de ltar dgu phrag gcig po de dag kyang dbang po tha ma'i tha ma dang*/ tha ma'i 'bring po dang*/ tha ma'i rab dang gsum gyi dbang du byas nas rim pa ltar/ tshig le'u gsum gsum brjod pa yin par shes par bya'o// gnyis pa dbang po 'bring gi dbang du byas te thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa la yang dgu ste sgo gsum las la sbyor ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ brtan g.yo dbang du sdud pa dang*/ nam mkha' ngal gso dang/ rang sems rdo rje kun rig gi dang*/ snying po bcud len gyi dang*/ gang shar rdzun snang gi dang*/ 'gal rkyen gzhi bral gyi dang*/ snyems byed rang sar dag pa'i dang*/

dug gsum gnas gyur gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ lus zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ lus kyi rdo rje skyil krung ri bo ltar g.yo 'gul med pa dang*/ ngag rlung rgyun rkyal par bsdam par ltar nang du bcings dang*/ sems nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ltar yongs su ngos bzung med pa chos thams cad kyis chos nyid la mnyam par 'jog go /zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ lus brtan zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ lus thabs mgal gyi phyag rgyas shing rta chas su bcug pa ltar bca'o// g.yo ba dbugs kyi rengs bu srog shing dbu ma'i nang du bcug pas/ 'bral med 'od gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin rang dbang du gyur pa 'chi med nam mkha' lta bu'i dngos grub thob bo// zhes bya ba'o// gsum pa ni/ nam mkha'i zhes pa la sogs ste nang rnam par mi rtog pa nam mkha'i ngang du ngal gso/ phyi yang dag lha'i rnal 'byor bde ba chen po'i ngang du ngal gso/ bde stong zung 'jug lhan cig (518)skyes pa'i gdangs gsal ba 'od gsal ngang du ngal gso/ ngal gso gsum gyis 'khor ba thog med nas dub pa rang sangs du gyur to// zhes bya ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ dang po ma bcos par glod pas rdo rje 'chang rang 'khrungs su sku bltams/ de nyid kyi ngang las sna tshogs su snang ba rdo rje rgyal po chos nyid yul la kha 'byams/ gang snang thams cad rang sar grol bas/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' stong ste/ de nyid kun rig tu sangs rgyas so// zhes bya ba'o// lnga pa ni/ me tog ces pa la sogs pa ste/ gzhan lus me tog lta bu las bde stong sbrang rtsi lta bur blang*/ rang sems chab rom lta bu la stong nyid chur zhu ba lta bur goms par bya/ lus la lus med kyi bde gsal zung 'jug gis sman bcud kyis len lta bu bsgrub pas/ rang sems rang gis rang mthong ba med pa'i tshul gyis mthong bas chos nyid mthong ba mthar thug tu 'gyur ro// zhes bya ba'o// drug pa ni/

chu nang zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ gang shar shar gyi ngo bo sus kyang ma bskyed pa chu nang gi skyes bu lta bu/ de'i rten dbang po la bdag med pa rmi lam gyi grong khyer lta bu/ shar ba gnas kyi rten dang bral ba me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur rtogs pas skye 'gro thams cad brdzun snang du thag chod do// zhes bya ba'o// bdun pa ni/ gang na zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ chos thams cad mi gnas pa'i yul sad pa rmi lam gyi skyes bu lta bu/ skye ba'i rgyu med pa sgyu ma'i log rtog lta bu/ 'gag pa'i dus med pa rmi lam gyi mar me lta bu/ nam mkha' thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong par rtogs pas 'gal rkyen bar chad kyis 'jigs pa med do// zhes bya ba'o// brgyad pa ni/ 'di dag ces pa la sogs pa ste/ yul bden brdzun gang yang snang stong dang*/ rig pa'i bde sdug gang shar yang rig stong yin pas (519)yul snang ba gang der kyang shes snyam yin la/ blo rig pas ci rig kyang rig snyam du thag chod de/ snyam pa de nyid snyam pas stong pas byed rang sar dag go zhes bya ba'o// dgu pa ni/ skyes bu zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang nyi ma ltar 'od gsal bas 'od gsal rdo rjer gnas gyur pa dang*/ 'dod chags zla ba ltar bde nyams kyis snang bas bde chen rdo rjer gnas gyur pa dang*/ gti mug sgra gcan 'dzin ltar mi rtog pas choms pas rtog med rdo rje 'chang du gnas gyur to// zhes bya ba'o// dgu phrag gcig po 'di dag kyang*/ dbang po 'bring gi dbang du byas nas/ dbang po 'bring gi tha ma dang*/ 'bring gi 'bring dang*/ 'bring gi rab gsum la rim pa ltar/ tshig le'u byas pa gsum gsum sbyar ba bya'o// gsum pa dbang po rab kyi dbang du byas te khyad par gyi rtogs pa brjod pa dgu ste/ dpe drug thabs ldan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ mtshan ma rang grol dang*/ thabs kyi thabs ldan gyi dang*/

'dzin pa rang sar dag pa'i dang*/ yi ge dang yi ge med pa'i dang*/ 'gro gnas 'gag med dang*/ rang sems gter rnyed kyi dang*/ sgyu ma bden bral gyi dang*/ sgyu ma sgyu bral gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ nam mkha'i zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ dpe drug las/ dang po ni/ nam mkha' stong pa las sprin glo bur du byung ba ltar/ chos nyid stong pa las rnam rtog glo bur du byung ba'o// gnyis pa rgya mtsho las rba rlabs byung yang rba rlabs de nyid du thim pa ltar/ skye med la skye ba'i nyams ci snang yang de nyid du thim pa'o// gsum pa me tog las sbrang rtsi blang du yod pa ltar lus la bde stong blang du yod pa'o// bzhi pa ga bur dang dri dbyer med pa ltar snang ba dang stong pa dbyer med pa'o// lnga pa me long dwangs pa la gzugs shar ba ltar/ rig pa dri ma med pas rig chos sna tshogs su 'char (520)ba'o// drug pas shel dkar po gzhan gyi kha dog gis mi 'gyur ba ltar ma bcos pa rkyen stobs kyis gzhan du mi 'gyur ba ste/ zhes bya ba'o// gnyis pa ni 'gro ba zhes pa la sogs ste/ skye 'gro mtho ris dang*/ ngan song ba'i bde sdug thams cad ni las las skyes/ las dkar nag ni nyon mongs pa las byung*/ de'i rgyu tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma yin te/ mtshan ma de nyid rang ngo shes na mtshan med yin pas/ bdag gis mtshan ma de rang sar grol bar rtogs so// zhes bya ba'o// gsum pa ni/ rtogs pa'i rgyu tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma yin te/ mtshan ma de nyid rang ngo shes na mtshan med yin pas/ bdag gis mtshan ma de rang sar grol bar rtogs so// zhes bya ba'o// gsum pa ni/ rtogs pa'i glang chen zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ thabs kyi khyad par bzhis thabs ldan gyi nyams myong bde blag tu bskyed pa ste/ yul sna tshogs la 'phros pa'i rtog mkhan rang ngo shes pas dgug pa glang po che lcags kyus bkug pa lta bu dang*/

rang lus gzhan lus kyi bde bas nyams myong gi rten byed pa me tog gi rtsi yis bung ba bsdud pa lta bu/ 'od gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin bde ba chen po'i ngang du brtse ba dang ba mtshon brtse ba lta bu/ gsol 'debs kyis bar chad sel zhing rtogs pa'i pad+ma kha 'byed pa nyi zer gyis 'dam skyes kha 'byed pa lta bu ste/ thabs kyis thabs ldan lam du slong ba'i man ngag bdag gis rtogs so zhes bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ yid kyi zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ de ltar khyad par gyi thabs bzhi pa/ thabs ldan gyi nyams myong gom pa'i phan yon mngon sum du 'byung ste/ glang chen lcags kyus bkug pa lta bu'i thabs kyis/ rig pa rang gsal gyi mar me yid kyi mun pa sel/ bung ba sbrang rtsi'i sdud pa lta bu'i thabs kyis bde ba'i sbrang rtsi'i rtog pa'i bung bas 'jib/ ngang pa mtsho nang rtse ba lta bu'i thabs kyis 'dzin pa'i rba rlabs rgya mtshor thim/ (521)pad+ma nyi zer gyis 'byed pa lta bu'i thabs kyis bde sdug gi sprin tshogs spros bral gyi nam mkhar dengs zhes bya ba'o// lnga pa ni/ yi ge gsum zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ yi ge gsum ni/ a dang*/ sa dang*/ ka dang gsum ste/ a a ma ni zhes rtogs byed kyi blo yid byed pa dang bral ba'o// pa pa ra mār+tha zhes pa rtogs bya don du ma grub pa don dam pa stong pa nyid/ ka kardza zhes pa/ rtogs byed blo yis rtogs bya'i don rtogs pa grub pa'i 'bras bus mtshan ma rang sar grol ba ste/ de ltar yi ge gsum gyis yi ge med par bstan pas yi ge'i rgyal po yi ge med par bdag gis rtogs zhes bya ba'o// drug pa ni/ gang du zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ rmi lam gyi ma shi ba gang du yang 'gro rgyu med pa ltar rnam rtog thams cad yul dang*/ yul dus 'di nas yul dus gzhan du 'gro rgyu med la/ rmi lam gyi pha 'ong la gnas med pa ltar rnam rtog la'ang phyi nang bar gsum gyi gnas med cing*/

gang gi gnas pa chos kyi dbyings yin pas nam mkha' 'gags pa med pa ltar rnam rtog la 'gag pa med de/ de ltar 'gro gnas 'gag med gsum gyi don bdag gis rtogs so// zhes bya ba'o// bdun pa ni/ rtag tu zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ gti mug gti mug gis rnam par dag pas sgrib pa med pa'i gter chen yin te/ gti mug gi byed pa mi shes par sgrib pa yin la/ rmi lam gyi mun pa ltar bsgribs pa'i dus su sgrib mkhan med pa'i phyir ro// khong khro khong khros rnam par dag pa 'khrugs pa med pa'i gter chen yin te/ khong khro'i byed pa sems kun nas 'khrugs pa yin pa la/ sgyu ma'i me lce 'khrugs pa bzhin du 'khrugs pa'i dus su 'khrugs mkhan med pa'i phyir ro// bag chags sam 'dod chags kyis rnam par dag pa zhen cing dkris pa med pa'i phyir (522)gter chen yin te/ 'dod chags kyi byed las zhen cing dkris pa yin pa la sbrul mdud pa rang sar grol ba bzhin du/ dkris pa'i dus su dkri mkhan med pa'i phyir ro// dug gsum rnam dag de nyid zhi ba mya ngan 'das kyi gter yin pas/ de nyid gzhan na ni med kyi rang la yod pa shes par gyis shig /ces bya'o// brgyad pa ni/ 'jig rten pa zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ 'di ltar snang ba'i 'jig rten ni sgyu ma lta bu'i las kyis bsgrub pa/ sgyu ma'i las de'ang sgyu ma lta bu'i yid kyis bsgrubs te/ rkun po ngos zin na des rku mi nus pa ltar/ sgyu mar shes pas bden zhen log pa ni sdug bsngal rang sar ldog go /zhes bya ba'o// dgu pa ni/ sgyu mar rtogs zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis te/ shes rab zab mos sgyu mar rtogs pas bden rtog dang bral la/ snying rje chen pos sgyu tsam yang mi gnas te/ sems can gyi don rgya cher byed pas shes rab dang snying rje zung 'jug sgrub pa la mkhas so// zhes bya ba'o// dgu khrag gcig po 'di dag kyang*/

skyes bu dbang po rab kyi dbang du byas te/ dbang po rab kyi tha ma dang*/ rab kyi 'bring dang*/ rab kyi rab rnams la go rim ltar/ tshig le'ur byas pa gsum gsum sbyar ba yang shes par bya'o// spyi don gsum pa sgrub pa mthar phyin pas don chen grub pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ mi gnas zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis te/ sngar smos pa ltar shes rab dang snying rje zung 'jug gi rtogs pa skyes pa/ yun ring po nas bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bus dag dod mthar phyin te/ thabs shes rab gnyis kyis 'khor 'das gnyis la mi gnas par/ rang don dang gzhan don phun sum tshogs pas/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po rnyed pa dang mtshungs so zhes bya ba'o// 'jig rten mgon pos rnam 'dren rgyal po la// do ha (523)rdo rje'i glu gsungs de ma thag /rgya las 'bur bzhin thugs la legs 'khrungs nyams// rtogs brjod sum cu'i rnam bshad mdo tsam bkrol// dge ba 'di yi rjes 'jug snying dkyil du// lhan cig ma rig 'thib po'i mun bsal nas// de rjes mkha' khyab ma rnams rang rig la'ang*// rang byung mngon rtogs dri med 'bar ba shog /rtogs pa brjod pa sum cu pa'i do ha rdo rje'i tshig 'bru rnam par bshad pa/ dge slong dpal gyi ming can gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so/// /
